description: On the empty group of p3, ten work files written by ADODB.Stream (9,000 patterned bytes named ext.txt, ext.TXT, ext.zip, ext.ZIP, ext.jpg, ext.JPG, ext-noext and ext.bin; empty.txt of 0 bytes; noise.bin of 9,000 pseudo-random bytes) are each loaded with child AddNew, FileData.LoadFromFile and Update under one parent Edit; the group is then read fresh (FileName, FileType, FileFlags, FileTimeStamp, FileData) and the closed file image is kept.
